command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$taskFiles = @(
  'CMakeLists.txt',
  'src/Infrastructure/Windows/Detail/DashboardConnectionRegistry.cpp',
  'src/Infrastructure/Windows/Detail/DashboardConnectionRegistry.h',
  'src/Infrastructure/Windows/Detail/DashboardConnectionRuntimeServices.cpp',
  'src/Infrastructure/Windows/Detail/DashboardConnectionRuntimeServices.h',
  'src/Infrastructure/Windows/Detail/DashboardConnectionState.cpp',
  'src/Infrastructure/Windows/Detail/DashboardConnectionState.h',
  'src/Infrastructure/Windows/Detail/DashboardListenerGeneration.cpp',
  'src/Infrastructure/Windows/Detail/DashboardListenerGeneration.h',
  'src/Infrastructure/Windows/Detail/DashboardFixedIocpKeyAuthority.cpp',
  'src/Infrastructure/Windows/Detail/DashboardFixedIocpKeyAuthority.h',
  'src/Infrastructure/Windows/Detail/DashboardListenerCompletionKeyLease.cpp',
  'src/Infrastructure/Windows/Detail/DashboardListenerCompletionKeyLease.h',
  'tests/Dashboard/DashboardConnectionRegistryTests.cpp',
  'tests/Dashboard/DashboardConnectionRuntimeServicesTests.cpp',
  'tests/Dashboard/DashboardConnectionStateTests.cpp',
  'tests/Dashboard/DashboardListenerGenerationTests.cpp',
  'tests/Dashboard/DashboardFixedIocpKeyAuthorityTests.cpp',
  'tests/Dashboard/DashboardListenerCompletionKeyLeaseTests.cpp',
  '.forge-codex/state/decisions/P16-015-fixed-iocp-authority-and-graceful-shutdown-cutover.md',
  '.forge-codex/state/evidence/P16/dashboard-fixed-key-graceful-cutover-checkpoint.json',
  '.forge-codex/state/run-state.json'
)
$taskStrictUtf8 = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false, $true)
foreach ($taskFile in $taskFiles) {
  $taskBytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Join-Path (Get-Location).Path $taskFile))
  if ($taskBytes.Length -ge 3 -and $taskBytes[0] -eq 0xEF -and $taskBytes[1] -eq 0xBB -and $taskBytes[2] -eq 0xBF) { throw "UTF-8 BOM: $taskFile" }
  $taskText = $taskStrictUtf8.GetString($taskBytes)
  if ($taskText -match '(?<!\r)\n|\r(?!\n)') { throw "Non-CRLF newline: $taskFile" }
  if ($taskBytes.Length -gt 0 -and -not $taskText.EndsWith("`r`n", [StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { throw "Missing final CRLF: $taskFile" }
}
Write-Output "Text policy passed: $($taskFiles.Count) files."
